memories.content: On 2026-07-09 Mara flew from Toronto to Lagos to visit her mother, departing Pearson airport before dawn on no sleep.
Mara was running on no sleep and a flat white at Pearson at 5:40am on the 2026-07-09 travel day.
Mara's bag was two kilos overweight at Pearson on 2026-07-09 and she repacked it on the floor by gate D32.
Mara cut a third pair of shoes from her luggage on the 2026-07-09 travel day to make the weight limit.
Mara packed a large supply of Canadian medicine for her mother on the Lagos trip, the good stuff her mother pretends not to want.
Mara lost a small gold hoop earring near airport security at Pearson on 2026-07-09.
Mara's 2026-07-09 Lagos flight was an Air France routing with a Paris (CDG) layover.
Mara was stuck in a middle seat on the 2026-07-09 Lagos flight, which she disliked but accepted because the price was the price.
Mara felt it was strange to leave the General behind even for two weeks during her Lagos trip.

entities.name: the General
entities.description: Toronto General Hospital, where Mara works

memories.content: Priyanka personally covered Mara's shifts while she was away in Lagos, further changing Mara's read on her.

entities.name: Priyanka
entities.description: charge nurse / manager at the General; distinct from Mara's friend Priya

memories.content: During the Paris layover on 2026-07-09 Mara texted Chidi her landing time; he confirmed he would pick her up at Murtala Muhammed airport in Lagos.
On the 2026-07-09 travel day Daniel texted Mara a heart and 'go hug your mum.'
Mara ate a croissant at the Paris CDG layover at 6am Paris time on 2026-07-09, jetlagged with her brain like soup.
The Lagos-bound leg from Paris was about eleven hours, which Mara planned to try to sleep through on 2026-07-09.
On her 2026-07-09 departure for Lagos, Mara felt scared but lighter than she had been all spring, relieved to finally be going to see her mother in person rather than on a screen.
Mara processed the long 2026-07-09 travel day in fragments between boarding zones, narrating each leg as it happened.
